command:
set -eu

openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.key
openssl req -new -sha256 -key /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.key -out /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.csr -subj '/CN=node2'
node2_ip=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node2" {print $1; exit}')

printf 'subjectAltName=DNS:node2,IP:%s\nbasicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\nsubjectKeyIdentifier=hash\nauthorityKeyIdentifier=keyid,issuer\n' "$node2_ip" > /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.ext
openssl x509 -req -sha256 -days 825 -in /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.csr -CA /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/ca.crt -CAkey /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/ca.key -CAcreateserial -out /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.crt -extfile /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.ext
chmod 0600 /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/ca.key /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.key
chmod 0644 /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/ca.crt /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.crt
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/ca.crt /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.crt
openssl x509 -in /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates
openssl x509 -in /etc/pki/fleet-internal-ca/node2.crt -noout -subject -issuer -ext subjectAltName
